description: OpenAI's previous generation embedding model. Produces 1536-dimensional embeddings. Superseded by text-embedding-3-small and text-embedding-3-large which offer better performance at lower cost.

trainingData.description: Trained on a large corpus of text data. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained using contrastive learning techniques. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Was state-of-the-art at release. Now superseded by text-embedding-3-small which offers better performance at lower cost.

knownLimitations: Lower performance than newer embedding models
Higher cost than text-embedding-3-small for similar performance
Consider migrating to text-embedding-3-small or text-embedding-3-large

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Embeddings may encode biases present in training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Input content filtering applied by OpenAI's usage policies.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Text sent to the API may be processed by OpenAI.
